rationale: The round 2 exchanges have sharpened and stabilized around the same core conflict: employee/state actors insist on no closures and no compulsory redundancies, while management/owners/investors continue to require those options to remain on the table. There is clearer acknowledgement of the need for burden-sharing and investment, but the substantive contested issues remain unresolved rather than converged, so another round could still test concrete trade-off scenarios.
